notes.title: Wrapturous Devlog #04
notes.content:
A new enemy called the Medjed has been created and has been added to the game. Additionally, I finished making alpha builds of all the levels for the full game, meaning we are getting closer and closer to the game's completion. Anyway, those that are fully supporting the game's development are able to play these alpha builds and witness the Medjed enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43309948/61e3f7a2e05fb64a3d965617f98c6276c0f788c4.gif[/img]

notes.title: Wrapturous Devlog #03
notes.content:
I've recently completed the alpha phase of all the levels in the game, aside from boss levels. What this means is while the levels lack proper visuals and some features aren't present, it does mean that the base skeleton for the game is basically set and now the focus is just adding the proper content and improvements. Those that are fully supporting the game's development are able to play these alpha builds and give thoughts to help shape them into what the final game will be.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43309948/c6ca31e0ed5375dc8d10fcbb12c787af343c548a.gif[/img]

notes.title: Wrapturous Devlog #02
notes.content:
These Clay Pots might have something to help aid Yui in her attempt to escape, but she better be careful cause breaking those pots will alert Mau (Cat-Girl). This is a new system I have added to the game and it is present in recent Level Build that I'm allowing people that are supporting the game's development play. I'm not sure if this mechanic will be shown in an updated Demo, but we'll see what happens.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43309948/753f955d41aed292410aab0a8384168718ddd92d.gif[/img]

notes.title: Wrapturous Devlog #01
notes.content:
I've decided that I'm gonna post more behind-the-scenes content of the full game's development to the public, and I thought I'd start with some improvements to the Wax Doll enemies. I experimented with them being able to chase the player, but I found many issues that forced me to abandon that system. However, I decided to go back and see about making the Wax Dolls able to chase Yui, and so far it looks like I've created a solid system for it. I'm looking at updating the public demo to feature this along with some other improvements I plan on showing later, but I hope to get more of the levels for the full game done before I update the demo.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43309948/13e1bf98d02afe9e56d3371e2220f0fee22f4e3b.gif[/img]
